name: Data Layer — Schema, Tables & Sharding
description: MySQL DDL and table definitions under sql/, Worker-node table, plus ShardingSphere sharding/encryption configuration for the order, pay, program and user databases.

name: Gateway & Service Entry Points
description: Spring Cloud Gateway edge routing, the admin monitoring service, and every Spring Boot application bootstrap class that starts a microservice.

name: Program & Search Domain
description: Ticket-program catalogue: program and seat management with Caffeine local caches, Redis Stream cache invalidation, Elasticsearch-backed program search, and the program client contracts.

name: User Domain
description: User accounts, login/token handling, mobile and email registration, sliding-captcha verification hooks, and the user client contracts used by other services.

name: Order & Payment Domain
description: Order creation, ticket-user binding and order cancellation plus payment/refund strategies (Alipay), their Kafka consumers and the order/pay/job client contracts.

name: Base Data & Customize Services
description: Reference data (areas/cities), configurable customize-service API data and broadcast management, plus the MyBatis-Plus integration service.

name: Shared Infrastructure Frameworks
description: Reusable in-house starters: Redis tooling and Stream support, Redisson distributed locks and the delay queue, distributed ID generation, thread pools, captcha/anti-bot, and the Spring Cloud common/gray-transition/initialize components.

name: Shared Common Utilities & Contracts
description: Cross-cutting utility classes, constants, enums, base entities and serialization helpers in damai-common that every service depends on.

name: Deployment & Build Infrastructure
description: Containerization and orchestration (Dockerfile, docker-compose with the full middleware stack), Maven aggregator POMs, the Spotless formatting profile and project documentation.
